book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Ruuka

content: Yeesu araryookibhwa
Etabhoori zuri orusiku rwo okutaanga rwo obhutuuro, abhakari bhayo bhakagya mumbiihira na amaguta go omuruumbaaso gano bhaari bhagabhanwiiri.
Hano bhaahikiri, bhakabhona eriigina eriikuru rino ryaari riribhiri mumbiihira, rihuungwiirwe embarika.
Niho bhakasikira muusi, kyaamwe bhakabhona ekituundu kyo Omukuru Yeesu kitarimu.
Hano bhaari bhakyaruguura iguru ye engʼana yiyo, kituukiro embarika waabhu, bhakiimeerera abhaatu bhabhiri, bhiibhohiri emyeenda gyo okumesyamesya.
Hano bharuuzi gayo, abhakari bhayo bhakagwaatwa no obhwoobha bhwaaru, niho bhakiihiinya tee haasi. Kyaamwe, abhaatu bhayo bhakabhabhuurira, “Ndora muramoohya omuhoru mubhaku?
Atari hano, aryookiri! Emwe mutakuhiita amangʼana garya yabhabhuuriiri, hano yaari akyaari Gariraaya?
Akabhuga, ‘Enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, nireenderwa nituurwe mumabhoko ga bhe ebhibhi, na bharaniitira kumusaraba, no orusiku rwa katatu ndaryooka.’ ”
Neebho bhakahiita amangʼana gayo ga Yeesu,
bhakarwa mumbiihira bhakagya kukeerenia na abheega bha Yeesu ikumi na wumwe, hamwe na abhaatu abhaandi bhoosi.
Abhakari bhayo ni Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara, Yoana, na Mariamu nina waabhu Yaakobo, hamwe na abhakari abhaandi bhano bhaari hamwe nabho.
Hano bhaagaambiri goosi gayo kubheega, bhakagarora kubha ni ga kizabhuri, bhataagiikiriirye.

Nawe, Petero akiimeerera, akaryaara bhwaangu kugya mubhubhi. Akiihiinya, akasoomya mumbiihira, akayirora engibho ndabhu yino bhaamubhiikiirimu Yeesu, giri hayo egyeene ego. Akarwa hayo, eno ariibhuurya omweene kino kituukiri.
Orugeendo rwo okugya Emau
Orusiku ruyoruyo, abhabhiri bha abheega bha Yeesu bhaari murugeendo rwo okugya mumugye gwa Emau. Omugye guyo, gwaari obhweema bhwa amataambuka ebhikwe ikumi na kimwe (11,000) okurwa Yerusaremu.
Na abhabhiri bhayo, bhaari bhariibhisirya iguru ya amangʼana goosi gano gaakorirwe.
Hano bhakwiibhuurya no okukeerenia, Yeesu woosi akaaza, akageenda hamwe nabho.
Nawe bhaari bhakuundikiriibhwe ameeso gaabhu, bhatamenyiri kubha niwe.
Akabhabhuurya, “Murakeereneryaki eno murageenda?” Bhakiimeerera, eno bhariingiri eziikomo zyaabhu.
Owumwe waabhu, eriina ryaaye niwe Kiriopa, akamukyoora, “Mubhagini bhoosi bha Yerusaremu, naawe omweene ego omugini, wuno oteenda wiigwa goosi gano gakorirwe eziisiku zino!”
Yeesu akabhuurya, “Ni mangʼanaki gayo?” Bhakamukyoora, “Amangʼana ga Yeesu wa Nazareeti. Niwe yaari omurooti wo obhunagya bhwo okukora no okugaamba embere wa Taatabhugya na abhaatu bhoosi.
Kyaamwe, abhakuru bha abhaseengeri na abhakaangati bheetu, bhakamutinira ekiina kubha yiitwe, niho bhakamwiita kumusaraba.
Na ewe niwe tumwiisigiiri kubha, aratutuurya etwe Abhiiziraeri. Okutuuma gayo goosi, reero ni rusiku rwa katatu kweema gaatuukiri.
“Hamwe na gayo, gati wa abhakari bhano bhaari bhe eweetu, bhakatutakya. Reero etabhoori zuri bhakagya kumbiihira,
bhakabhona omubhiri gutari muusi muyo, bhiiziri kutubhuurira kubha bhatuukiirwe na bhamaraika bhano bhabhabhuuriiri kubha Yeesu ni muhoru.
Na abhaandi bhano bhaari hamwe na neetwe, bhakagya mubhubhi bhakabhona niigo ego kyeego abhakari bharya bhaagaambiri, nawe Yeesu bhataamuruuzi.”
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Emwe bhageege bhano, kwaki mutakunagya kwiikirirya, kwaki ni bhakongʼu ego kwiikirirya gano gaagaambirwe na abharooti?
Ndora Masiya akeenderwa kuhitira enyaako yoosi yiyo, Taatabhugya aramukora aguungibhwe?”
Niho, akabhagarurira amangʼana goosi gano gakaamirwe iguru waaye, kweemera ebhitabhu bhya Musa, tee ebhitabhu bhyoosi bhya abharooti.
Na hano bhaari bhariisuka mumugye muyo, Yeesu akiikora kubha akyaageenderera no orugeendo.
Niho bhakamwiisasaama bhukongʼu, “Wiikare hamwe neetwe hano! Ndora ritubhiiri ne ekiirima kiiziri.” Niho, Yeesu akasikira yiika kwiikara nabho.
Na hano bhakiikara kubhyaakurya, Yeesu akagega omukaate, akagusabhira, akagubhega, akabhaha.
Hayohayo, bhakarimurwa ameeso gaabhu, bhakamumenyeekererya kubha ni Yeesu. Kyaamwe akabhabhuraku.
Bhakiibhuurira, “Hano twaari munzira, akatukeerenerya gano gaari mu Makaamo Amahoreeru, tutasaambarukiri bhukongʼu muziikoro zeetu?”
Bhakabhuuka kwiibhaga riyoriyo, bhakakyoora Yerusaremu. Eyo bhakabhabhona abheega bha Yeesu ikumi na wumwe bhiikumeenie hamwe na abhaandi.
Abheega bhakabhabhuurira, “Ni heene, Omukuru Yeesu aryookiri, amuhwaarukiiri Simooni.”
Niho bhakazweenia abharikyaabhu gano gabhatuukiiri munzira, bhakabhabhuurira kyeego bhaamumenyiri Yeesu hano yabhegiri omukaate.
Yeesu arahwaarukira abhaanabheega bhaaye
Hano abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhayo bhaari bhakwiibhisirya iguru ya gayo, hasuuhwiigo Yeesu omweene akiimeerera gati waabhu. Akabhabhuurira, “Omureembe gubhe neemwe.”
Bhakiitakya, bhakoobhoha bhukongʼu, kwo okubha bhakiiseega kubha bharuuzi omusaambwa.
Kyaamwe, Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Ndora muhoobhiri bhukongʼu, na kwaki mwiitiimaatiri muziikoro zyeenyu?
Muniisuunze amabhoko gaane na amaguru gaane, niho mumenye kubha neenye. Mungwaateku, mwiirorere abheene! Omusaambwa gutana minoku na gutana maguha, nawe, kyaabhurya mukuundora enye ninabhyo bhiyo.”
Kyaamwe, akabheerekya amabhoko gaaye na amaguru gaaye.
Abheega bhaaye, bhakazomererwa bhukongʼu eno bharuguuriri, nawe bhatiikiriirye gayo ni go obhuheene. Niho, Yeesu akabhabhuurya, “Mune ebhyaakurya bhyobhyoosi hano?”
Bhakamuha ekitinika kye eswe ekaru,
akakigega, akakirya embere waabhu.

Kyaamwe akabhabhuurira, “Gano nigo garya niabhabhuuriiri eriibhaga niari hamwe na neemwe, kubha garaakorwe gano goosi gakaamirwe iguru waane mumigiro gya Musa, na mubhitabhu bhya abharooti, na mukitabhu kya Zaburi.”
Hayo, Yeesu akabhasakirya no okubhagarurira kumenya Amakaamo Amahoreeru.
Akabhabhuurira, “Ekaamirwe kubha Masiya aranyaakibhwa no orusiku rwa katatu araryooka kurwa mubhaku.
Na abhaatu bha mubhyaaro bhyoosi, kweemera hano Yerusaremu, bhareegibhwa kuriina ryaaye kubha bhate ebhibhi bhyaabhu, niho bharaabhirwe.
Emwe neemwe abhamenyeekererya bha amangʼana gayo gaatuukiri.
“Murore! Ndabhareetera emwe Ekoro Muhoreeru kyeego Taata yabharageenie, kubha mwiikare mumugye guno tee Ekoro Muhoreeru yiize abhiizurirye obhunagya kurwa mwiisaaro.”
Yeesu aragegwa kugya mwiisaaro
Kyaamwe, Yeesu akabhakaangata abhaanabheega bhaaye, haguhi no omugye gwa Betania. Hano bhaahikiri hayo, akagorora amabhoko gaaye iguru kwo okubhatweera ebhite.
Na hano yaari arabhatweera ebhite, niho ewe akabhatiga kwo okugegwa kugya mwiisaaro.
Hayo bhakamuseengera, kyaamwe bhakakyoora Yerusaremu, eno bhazomereerwe bhukongʼu.
Neebho bhakiikara mwiiseengerero, bhakabha bharamukumya Taatabhugya.
